name: Rezlak
summary: Along Durotar’s roads south of Orgrimmar, Rezlak waits for help keeping his supplies moving. The goblin belongs to the Tinkers’ Union and hires travelers to recover lost goods and drive off harpies.

sections.title: A Pragmatic Tinkers' Union Agent
sections.body: Rezlak waits beside the canyon road between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar. He represents the Tinkers’ Union, a goblin syndicate devoted to engineering, supply lines, and practical business. While trade runs smoothly, the factional tensions of Kalimdor matter little to him. Dustwind harpies have raided his cargo caravans and made the routes unsafe. So Rezlak stays at his post and hires passersby to recover supplies and deal with the harpies for profit.

faq.answer: Rezlak is a goblin merchant and engineer with the Tinkers’ Union. One of Gazlowe’s men, he was sent to help the orcs of Durotar. He waits along the main northern road for help securing supply lines and reclaiming gear from local pests.

faq.q: What is Rezlak doing in Durotar?
faq.answer: Rezlak works along the trade routes between the central plains and the canyon pass to Orgrimmar. Dustwind harpies ambushed his caravans and scattered cargo across the arid canyons, making the routes unsafe.
Rezlak offers two jobs. ‘Winds in the Desert’ asks you to recover sacks of lost supplies scattered across the canyon floor. ‘Securing the Lines’ asks you to thin the nearby Dustwind harpies.

The Tinkers’ Union is a goblin trade organization for mechanics, inventors, and logistical work. Like other goblin cartels and guilds, its members put profitable trade and practical solutions ahead of political loyalty.

angles.text: As an engineer, you understand why Rezlak prizes mechanical efficiency, useful tools, and salvaged components.
As a member of the Horde, you meet Rezlak just outside Orgrimmar. His dealings reflect the transactional ties between neutral goblin guilds and the fledgling Horde.
